# CloudNexus DevOps Automation Framework  
A cloud-native CI/CD orchestration toolkit designed to accelerate enterprise deployment pipelines via declarative infrastructure and service automation.  

## Badges  
[![GitHub](https://github.com/omarfarooq/cloudnexus/actions/workflows/main.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/omarfarooq/cloudnexus/actions/workflows/main.yml)  
[![CI/CD Status](https://github.com/omarfarooq/cloudnexus/actions/workflows/ci-cd.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/omarfarooq/cloudnexus/actions/workflows/ci-cd.yml)  
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](https://github.com/omarfarooq/cloudnexus/blob/main/LICENSE)  

## Tech Stack  
- **Core**: Python 3.9, Terraform 1.5, Ansible 2.14, Kubernetes 1.25  
- **Monitoring**: Prometheus 2.34 + Grafana 10.1  
- **Cloud**: AWS EKS, GCP Cloud Run (minimal footprint)  
- **Networking**: Calico CNI, IPsec tunnels for hybrid environments  
- **CLI**: Bash 5.1, AWS CLI 2, Terraform CLI  
- **APIs**: REST endpoints for dynamic pipeline configuration  

## Architecture / Design  
CloudNexus operates as a microservices-layered framework, decoupling infrastructure provisioning (Terraform), configuration management (Ansible), and runtime orchestration (Kubernetes). The core CLI synthesizes declarative YAML manifests into dynamic API requests, enabling real-time pipeline adjustments. Prometheus metrics are ingested via ServiceMonitor to track deployment latency and resource utilization.  

## Getting Started / Installation  
1. Clone the repo: `git clone https://github.com/omarfarooq/cloudnexus.git`  
2. Install dependencies:  
   ```bash  
   pip install -r requirements.txt  
   terraform init  
   ansible-galaxy install -r requirements.yml  
   ```  
3. Configure cloud credentials in `.env` (AWS/GCP access keys)  

## Usage / Examples  
```bash  
# Deploy a multi-cloud service  
cloudnexus deploy --manifest services/ecommerce.yaml --cloud aws  

# Monitor pipeline health  
cloudnexus metrics --namespace cloudnexus --exporter prometheus  

# Rollback failed deployment  
cloudnexus rollback --pipeline-id 789 --stage prod  
```  
Example manifests leverage Terraform modules for VPC isolation and Ansible playbooks for containerd configuration.  

## Contributing  
Submit PRs with unit tests covering CLI edge cases (e.g., invalid manifest syntax). Code must adhere to PEP8 and Terraform fmt standards. All contributions require a signed CLA.
